boundary: The original matrix-level proxy remains in old source/artifacts. This component computes the intended individual-entry statistic from actual saved values, using the existing base and checkpoint anchors. Full geometry/dimension/publication integration remains required. It creates no optimizer finding.

measurement.comparison: Exact saved-value inequality after lossless conversion to float64; no tolerance, threshold, norm or gradient
measurement.cumulative_anchor: The same immutable untrained initialization for every stage
measurement.denominator: All individual parameters in all 88 hidden matrices, including unchanged entries and zero-displacement matrices
measurement.numerator: Number of individual hidden-matrix parameters whose saved values differ from the declared anchor
measurement.old_proxy: Parameter mass of matrices having any nonzero displacement; not the fraction of individual parameters changed
measurement.saved_segment_anchor: Initialization at the first retained stage, otherwise the immediately preceding retained checkpoint
